title: Completion landed: every ask is accounted for, session is red at 41%

owner_note.text: Dropped-work flag, deferral with a home and decide-by, per-session deferral+stop rate, the proof check and Reopen are live, and the close-out walk settled all 172 idle asks of the session (92 done, 15 duplicate, 2 noise, 63 deferred with a home). The session is red: 41% of owner asks are deferred or stopped (63 deferrals to modules; the 7-day decide-by is the default), and DoneCheck flags 22 completions as "marked done, not done" you can reopen from the page. Queued tasks are not counted as dropped (alternative: flag "never started after N days"). The walk cost $16, 3.5x its estimate.
